about_the_game:
Pathfinder 2 RPG - NPC Core

Populate Your World!

Devotees of the gods, cunning mercenaries, fun-loving performers, crafty engineers, devious villains and more all have roles in your game with the Pathfinder NPC Core! Over 250 stat blocks for NPCs let you drop all kinds of characters into your game, from servants and farmers to masters of magic and martial arts. The NPCs are crafted to be fun and easy to use, with sets of adjustments to quickly change their ancestry, level, and more. You'll also find a trove of NPCs specific to non-human ancestries, like a dwarf general, goblin get-gang, and kobold egg guardian. Each section of NPCs is themed, and includes lore, custom rules, and random tables to spice up your gameplay. Never find yourself making up statistics on the fly again--you can find everything you need in the Pathfinder NPC Core!

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:

<ul> <li> Many new NPCs to choose from, complete with automation and insights into their use.</li>
<li> New tables to allow quick, varied creation of NPC details.</li>
<li> Easy NPC adjustment guidelines to make it easy to alter the various NPC for different Ancestries or Cultures.</li>
<li> New rules and details on Pets, Familiars, and Companions.</li>
<li> New Themed Spell Lists and Sample Organizations.</li>
<li> New Rules on Relationships between NPCs and PCs plus NPC Advancement guidelines.</li>
<li> Beautifully crafted images with rich details giving visuals to accompany the information that comes in the book.</li>
</ul>"
